section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1980
title: 25 ## Causes of Suicides : The total number of suicide cases reported during 1980 has been classified under different heads and the last category 'Other Causes' covers the unspecified causes of suicides sharing 54.6 percent of the total suicides. Among the important causes of suicides 'Dreadful diseases' was the major cause of suicides during 1980 which accounted for 13.0 percent of total suicides. The second important cause was 'Quarrel with parents-in-law' (7.6%) followed by 'Love Affairs' (5.4%), 'Quarrel with spouse' (5.0%), 'Insanity' (3.2%), 'Poverty' (2.8), 'Dispute over Property' (2.7%), 'Failure in Examination' (1.7%), 'Unemployment' and 'Fall in Social Reputation' both (1.2%) and 'Bankruptcy or sudden change in economic position' and 'Deaths of Dear Persons' both (0.8%). The detailed statistics are presented in Table-III.
